name: finance-dashboard-api
description: Restaurant Automation SaaS with an integrated FinanceOS dashboard

scripts.start: concurrently -k "npm run start --prefix restaurant-saas/backend" "npm run preview --prefix restaurant-saas/frontend -- --host 0.0.0.0" "npm run start:finance"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev --prefix restaurant-saas" "npm run dev:finance"
scripts.build: npm run build:closeout && npm run build --prefix restaurant-saas
scripts.test: npm run test:finance && npm run test:restaurant && npm run test:closeout

author: Finance API
